summary: Department owners can extend their people's access before it ends, without waiting for an administrator.

new.title: My people: extend access before it ends
new.text: The new My people page shows department owners when each person's access ends. They can extend it, up to a year ahead by default, and every extension is audited.

new.title: A reminder two days before access ends
new.text: Owners get a reminder two days before a person's access ends, and the mail opens My people at that person.

fixes.title: Central removals reach managed tenants
fixes.text: Removals, renames and session revokes from the managing tenant now reach managed tenants. Removals recorded in the last 30 days are delivered after this update.
